name: @excellent-so/pressroom
description: Write posts locally, preview them, and publish each one as a git commit that contains only that post's file. Zero dependencies.
author: Excellent
//dependencies: Zero runtime dependencies. Frontmatter is parsed and written by a small gray-matter-compatible pair (no YAML library); publishing runs the system `git`; the viewer is one HTML file (with the CSS of @excellent-so/kit, MIT, inlined) served by Node's built-in http. Nothing is downloaded at run time and nothing is sent anywhere but your own git remote.
